articles.summary: KAI Proximity is a new proximity targeting capability in KNOREX XPO that lets advertisers build aggregated, location-driven audiences through real-world points of interest (POIs) sorted by category, keyword and location, to be used in Programmatic, Meta Ads and Google Ads campaigns. Where people go can provide many clues about what they are looking for. For… Read More » Introducing KAI Proximity: Proximity Targeting for the Places That Matter.
